entities.summary: Alberta Kinsey was an American painter. Born in West Milton, Ohio, she was trained in New Orleans, France and Italy. She taught at Wilmington College and became an artist in New Orleans' French Quarter. Her work can be seen at the Smithsonian American Art Museum.
